messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "easing the urge-to-move sensation"
set: ["easing the urge-to-move sensation", "easing BPH symptoms", "check the instructions on the label", "throw the bag in the trash", "this is the reason for the recommendation", "use the dropper supplied with the bottle", "enlargement of the walls of the left side of the heart", "swelling of the lining of the joints", "slowing down the outer layer of the brain", "metformin around the time of the test", "narrowing of the airways in the lungs", "breakdown of the lining of the joints", "tighten the airways", "inflammation in the lining of the nose", "increasing the supply of blood to the heart", "take in either the morning or the evening"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
